title: Favorite sites of one-dimensional transient random walk
summary: In this paper, we study favorite sites of one-dimensional transient random walk on $\mathbb{Z}$ beyond the simple case. Denote by $\mathcal{K}(n)$ the set of favorite sites at time $n$. The goal of this paper is twofold. First, we study $\# \mathcal{K}(n)$, the cardinality of $\mathcal{K}(n)$, and show that, under some mild conditions, for any positive integer $k$, $\mathbf{P}(\#\mathcal{K}(n)=k, {\rm i.o.})=1$, and $\limsup_{n\to\infty}\#\mathcal{K}(n)/\log\log n=-1/\log γ$, where $γ$ is the probability that the random walk never returns to the starting point.
